About.title: About NorthShift Jobs
About.intro: We're a Canadian job board dedicated to connecting skilled nurses with rural, remote, and northern communities that need them most.
About.missionBody: Rural and northern healthcare facilities across Canada face a persistent nursing shortage. NorthShift Jobs exists to bridge that gap — making it easy for contract nurses to find meaningful work in underserved communities, and for healthcare employers to find qualified candidates quickly.
About.whyBody: Remote and northern communities often have no hospitals within hundreds of kilometres. Contract nurses fill critical gaps in emergency care, long-term care, and community health. Every filled position means better outcomes for patients who would otherwise go without care.
About.whoBody: We serve registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, nurse practitioners, and other allied health professionals seeking contract roles — as well as the health authorities, hospitals, and clinics in rural and remote Canada looking to staff them.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: NorthShift Jobs ("we", "us") operates northshift.ca. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
Privacy.s1Body: When you apply for a position we collect your name, email address, phone number, and nursing licence details you provide. When employers register, we collect their organization name and email. We also collect standard server logs (IP addresses, browser type, pages visited).
Privacy.s2Body: Applicant data is shared only with the employer who posted the listing you applied to. We use your email to send application confirmations and, if you opt in, job alert emails. Employer account data is used solely to operate the service.
Privacy.s3Body: If you subscribe to job alerts, we store your email and preferences to send matching notifications. Every alert email contains a one-click unsubscribe link. We do not sell or share alert subscriber data with third parties.
Privacy.s4Body: Application data is retained for 12 months from submission, then deleted. Job alert subscriptions are retained until you unsubscribe. Employer account data is retained for the life of the account plus 30 days after cancellation.
Privacy.s5Body: We use only essential session cookies required to operate the site. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking pixels.
Privacy.s6Body: Under Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), you have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, correct inaccuracies, and withdraw consent at any time. To make a request, contact us at hello@northshift.ca.
